lines.text: Frankson Library Renovation and
Temporary Relocation
Attention University Community:
Beginning October 10, the Frankson Library will undergo a major
renovation to enhance study spaces and technological resources.
The project is scheduled to continue through March 15.
During this period, the library's operational services will be
temporarily relocated to the second and third floors of the Meyer
Student Union Building. The temporary library spaces will operate
weekdays from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. and on weekends from
Library administrative offices will be temporarily relocated to the
university's Main Building.
Extra shuttle buses will run between the Main Quad and the
Meyer Student Union Building to accommodate increased traffic.
Students are encouraged to explore our expanded digital resources
available through the university's online portal.
We appreciate your patience as we improve our facilities.
For updates, visit the library's webpage or contact
library@university.edu.
